device.description: 8-bit micropower rail-to-rail voltage-output DAC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: dac081s101.pdf (SNAS323C) p.2 (pin configuration and descriptions), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.5 V, inputs -0.1 V to VA + 0.1 V), p.6 (AC and timing characteristics), p.7 (Figure 2 timing), p.14 (serial interface), p.15 (input shift register Figure 36, power-on reset, Table 2 power-down modes)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: D7-D0 (DB11-DB4 of the 16-bit input shift register); power-on zero (p.15)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: executed on the 16th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high before it aborts the frame (p.15)

pages: p.2 (pin configuration and descriptions), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.5 V, inputs -0.1 V to VA + 0.1 V), p.6 (AC and timing characteristics), p.7 (Figure 2 timing), p.14 (serial interface), p.15 (input shift register Figure 36, power-on reset, Table 2 power-down modes)
notModeled: VOUT and the resistor string (analog; VA is also the reference); the power-down output terminations are stored in CTRL.PD only
wake-up time 6-39 us, settling time 5 us max

the SPI mode: data is taken on SCLK falling edges after SYNC falls (Figure 2 shows SCLK low at SYNC fall, then rising, then the DB15 falling edge): mode 1; a continuously running SCLK that is high at SYNC fall also works on the hardware
